cast/string/from-integral-ternary.reason: The ternary's branches are int literals, which CEL renders in plain decimal ("1000000"), but the plan ships an int and a double constant as the same bare number and $toString over a double renders the exponent form ("1e+06"), so the adapter refuses string() over an untyped integral constant of 1e6 or more

cast/string/negated-from-integral-ternar.reason: Same untyped integral constant under string() as `cast/string/from-integral-ternary`, under negation

collection/except/equals-list-literal.reason: This adapter refuses this planner shape at its lowering boundary: Unsupported operator inside aggregation expression: except.

collection/except/size-of-difference.reason: This adapter refuses this planner shape at its lowering boundary: Unsupported operator inside aggregation expression: except.

collection/exists/map-keys.reason: The macro ranges over a to-one relation, which CEL reads as a map and iterates by KEY; the adapter translates a macro only as an element match over a collection relation's subdocuments, and a MongoDB filter has no form that iterates a subdocument's field names

collection/exists/negated-map-keys.reason: Same macro over a to-one relation's keys as `collection/exists/map-keys`, under negation: neither the filter nor the three-valued evaluation has a form that iterates a subdocument's field names.

hierarchy/ancestor-of/empty-delimiter.reason: Same empty-separator refusal as `hierarchy/descendent-of/empty-delimiter`: the ancestor $in list is built by splitting the path on its separator, and an empty separator splits it into characters whose prefixes leave out the empty string (a8's zero-segment ancestor)

hierarchy/descendent-of/empty-delimiter.reason: The hierarchy operand parser refuses an empty separator before the anchored `^prefix + separator` regex is built: with an empty separator that regex would match the path itself (a2, never its own descendant) as well as every string extension of it.

hierarchy/overlaps/empty-delimiter.reason: Same empty-separator refusal as `hierarchy/descendent-of/empty-delimiter`: overlaps is the ancestor $in list and the anchored descendant regex joined, and neither has a form for an empty separator

hierarchy/overlaps/path-built-from-ident.reason: the descendant path is CONSTRUCTED by list() from a constant segment and the primary key rather than read from a field, and the adapter resolves a hierarchy operand only from a mapped field or a string constant — it has no form for a path assembled at query time.

hierarchy/overlaps/path-built-from-list-.reason: This adapter refuses this planner shape at its lowering boundary: hierarchy path must be a field or string value.

membership/in/map-attribute-keys.reason: `in` over a to-one relation, which CEL reads as a map and tests by KEY; the keys are the fields the embedded subdocument carries, and the adapter has no filter over a subdocument's field names, so it refuses

membership/in/negated-map-attribute-keys.reason: Same key membership over a to-one relation as `membership/in/map-attribute-keys`, under negation

principal/except/size-after-removing-res.reason: This adapter refuses this planner shape at its lowering boundary: Unsupported operator inside aggregation expression: except.

principal/map/membership-in-mapped-list.reason: map() over a literal list whose projection reads a resource attribute: the plan's list is built per document, and the adapter has no aggregation form for map(), which a lambda over a constant list would need; membership in it is refused.

regex/matches/bounded-repetition.reason: This adapter refuses this planner shape at its lowering boundary: matches pattern is outside the supported common RE2/PCRE2 subset.

regex/matches/brace-without-count-is-lit.reason: The adapter refuses this planner shape at its existing lowering boundary: matches pattern is outside the supported common RE2/PCRE2 subset (a brace RE2 reads literally, PCRE2 as a quantifier).

regex/matches/case-fold-kelvin-and-long-.reason: The adapter refuses this planner shape at its existing lowering boundary: matches pattern is outside the supported common RE2/PCRE2 subset (an inline (?i) flag, whose Unicode folding orbits RE2 and PCRE2 do not share).

regex/matches/case-insensitive-flag.reason: This adapter refuses this planner shape at its lowering boundary: matches pattern is outside the supported common RE2/PCRE2 subset.

regex/matches/digit-class.reason: This adapter refuses this planner shape at its lowering boundary: matches supports only literal escapes in the common RE2/PCRE2 subset.

regex/matches/grouped-alternation.reason: This adapter refuses this planner shape at its lowering boundary: matches pattern is outside the supported common RE2/PCRE2 subset.

regex/matches/literal-brace.reason: This adapter refuses this planner shape at its lowering boundary: matches pattern is outside the supported common RE2/PCRE2 subset.

regex/matches/lookahead-from-principal.reason: Lookahead is outside RE2; the translator rejects patterns outside the common RE2/PCRE2 subset.

regex/matches/lucene-reserved-characters.reason: This adapter refuses this planner shape at its lowering boundary: matches pattern is outside the supported common RE2/PCRE2 subset.

regex/matches/negated-invalid-patterns-f.reason: The adapter refuses this planner shape at its existing lowering boundary: matches pattern is outside the supported common RE2/PCRE2 subset. PCRE2 accepts patterns RE2 rejects ((a)\1, a literal {2}a), so a pattern outside the subset cannot be sent to $regex and is refused.

regex/matches/posix-character-class.reason: This adapter refuses this planner shape at its lowering boundary: matches pattern is outside the supported common RE2/PCRE2 subset.

regex/matches/posix-class-and-range-boun.reason: The adapter refuses this planner shape at its existing lowering boundary: matches pattern is outside the supported common RE2/PCRE2 subset (bracket expressions and counted repetition).

regex/matches/top-level-alternation-pref.reason: matches() with an anchored top-level alternation (^o|e$): the pattern is outside the RE2/PCRE2 subset the adapter proves MongoDB's $regex reads identically, so it is refused.

regex/matches/top-level-alternation-sing.reason: This adapter refuses this planner shape at its lowering boundary: matches pattern is outside the supported common RE2/PCRE2 subset.

regex/matches/whitespace-class.reason: The adapter refuses this planner shape at its existing lowering boundary: matches supports only literal escapes in the common RE2/PCRE2 subset, and PCRE2's \s also matches a vertical tab that RE2's does not.

string/concatenate/field-to-field.reason: a CONSTANT is what tells CEL's two `+` overloads apart, and between two field paths there is none. MongoDB spells the two differently — $add accepts numeric and date types only, $concat strings — and the mapper carries no field types, so neither can be chosen. Sending $add anyway is what the server aborts the whole query on, so the shape is refused at translation instead.

string/concatenate/ordering.reason: Same refusal as `string/concatenate/field-to-field`: `+` between two field paths has no constant to tell CEL's string and numeric overloads apart, and the plan carries no field types, so neither $concat nor $add can be chosen

timestamp/equals/field-to-field-without-.reason: Bare temporal field comparison cannot preserve CEL string equality: stored Dates discard the original lexical spelling; compare timestamp(...) values instead.

type-mismatch/descendent-of/number-field.reason: hierarchy requires a string field: the declared scalar type cannot be compared with a path prefix.

type-mismatch/has-intersection/resource-.reason: hasIntersection against a map element: the relation's element field declares no scalar type, and a query $in with an embedded-document needle compares it field by field in stored order, and also matches an array-valued element field that merely contains it, where CEL's map equality ignores order and a list never equals a map.
